race.comment: CATCH A PRINCESS (10) resumed from a spell last start with a sound second over 1400m at Warrnambool. Won't find this as tough so she is a major player. INTERVENED (2) resumed from a spell last start with a sound second over 1550m at St Arnaud after being prominent at the turn. Finds a tougher race but a big run will not surprise. SOME CHANCE (14) finished third last start at the first run back from a spell over 1400m at Echuca, beaten 2.5 lengths. Likely improver with bright prospects. HE'S ON SONG (1) was last at the races when he finished fourth over 2218m at Donald on July 11. Has to be respected.
